description: Provider-native personal controller and specialist agents shared by Claude Code and Codex, with automatic Alan Wake routing for requested human-facing prose.

interface.shortDescription: Shared controller, analysis, exploration, and writing-agent routing.
interface.longDescription: Maintains one canonical prompt catalog and renders provider-native Claude Markdown and Codex TOML agents. Claude runs a Fable controller with Sonnet workers; Codex keeps its configured primary GPT model and uses GPT-5.6 custom workers. Requested Slack, Jira, PR/MR, email, documentation, release-note, status, decision, and handoff prose is automatically drafted by Alan Wake after facts are verified.
